title: Word Break
microsoftNote: dp[i] = whether s[:i] can be segmented.
statement: Given a string `s` and a dictionary `wordDict`, return `true` if `s` can be segmented into a space-separated sequence of one or more dictionary words. Words may be reused.
constraints: s and words consist of lowercase letters.
editorial: dp[0]=True. For i in 1..n, if some word ends at i and dp[i-len] and s[i-len:i]==word.
